tactical/button-primary.prompt:
A UI button of the button primary of the tactical UI style for a squad tactics game of briefings, loadouts and grid maps: its border and face, its centre plain so a label reads on it.
Style: Cinematic realism. Believable materials, human proportions and natural light, organised by cinematic framing, depth and colour control. Physically based materials, natural light, film-like grading and lenses, composition from cinema.
Palette: free, graded; one grade per area; avoid oversaturation; skin tones protected.
Nine-slice: the corners (19% left, 32% top, 19% right, 32% bottom of each cell) keep their size, the edges between them stretch along one axis and the centre both ways: put every ornament in the corners, keep the edges even along their length and the centre plain.
Background: fully transparent, nothing outside the subject.
Line: none, no outline.
Reference: the image shows the style; match its palette, line and rendering, not its content.
Avoid: flat ambient light; saturated game-y colours; stylised outlines; a background or ground shadow; text, letters or watermarks.
Shape: one single button-primary only, centred, filling the image across its width, 2.18 times as wide as it is tall (96 x 44 proportions); nothing else in the image.
Art direction: The primary button: a flat rectangle of field olive (#aabb76) filling the whole piece, an even light olive face so near-black text reads on it, a 1 px darker olive edge (#7d8a4e), square corners, a short near-black bracket tick inside its top-left and bottom-right corners. Hovered: a little lighter. As the selected LOADOUT 1 tab and the selected settings row of the concept. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.
The reference images are the approved concept of this style's screens: paint this piece as it appears there, in their exact material, colour, ornament and finish; do not copy their layout or text.
